name: Branded to Fall
source:
Follow two protagonists, Elora and Cam, both adventurers and a couple, as they are sent to large but isolated town of Valstead. There they find themselves falling prey to not just demons schemes but the townsfolk as well! 

How far will each protagonist go to save the other? What are they willing to sacrifice? Will they come out of this strong together, or fall to the power and pleasures they find there? 

[From [url=https://baconsoap.itch.io/branded-to-fall]Itch.io[/url]]
